description: Get computed geometry and population statistics for a given wheel/tyre specification. All fields optional. Provide as many as known for precise results. Returns geometry hints (backspace, frontspace, clearance estimates), population stats (how many vehicles use this spec), and optional human-readable fitment hints when hints=true. Useful for explaining fitment math to users or validating a spec before ordering.

aspect_ratio.description: Tyre aspect ratio as a percentage integer 1-100 (e.g. 45). Required for tyre/package mode. Mutually exclusive with overall_diameter.

bolt_pattern.description: Bolt pattern (PCD) as stud-count × circle-diameter in mm (e.g. "5x114.3"). Narrows population statistics to matching vehicles.

cb.description: Centre bore diameter in mm (e.g. 71.6). Must be positive. Passed through for package suggestions.

hints.description: Include human-readable fitment hints in the response (default false).

overall_diameter.description: Overall tyre diameter in inches (e.g. 33). Must be positive. For high-flotation (HF) tyre mode. Mutually exclusive with section_width/aspect_ratio.

rim_diameter.description: Rim diameter in inches (e.g. 18). Must be positive.

rim_offset.description: Rim offset (ET) in mm, range -100 to 100 (e.g. 25). Enables geometry and fitment-match estimates when provided.

rim_width.description: Rim width in inches (e.g. 8.0). Must be positive.

section_width.description: Tyre section width in mm (e.g. 225). Must be positive. Required for tyre/package mode. Mutually exclusive with overall_diameter.

name: wheel-spec-metadata
